analysis.visual_description: The letter, open. A worn letter on the tiring-house table, three weeks in a pocket, opened and folded once more. No sum has been copied onto your tables.
The letter, open. The lower lines of the letter are there and are not transferred. Your tables, beside it, have the place and the two days and a blank where a figure would go.
The letter, open. One line of the letter still showing as Sly left it, the rest covered by the fold.
